experimental_method: Gasometric saturation (Ben-Naim and Baer type): degassed sample in a stirred glass vessel in a thermostat, gas volume absorbed at constant pressure read on a mercury gas burette, sample weighed; Bunsen coefficient computed.
uncertainties_stated: Estimated total instrumental uncertainty about 0.019 x 10^3 at 20 C (Table 1); coefficient of variation 0.13 percent (O2 replicates) and 0.15 percent (N2 distilled water duplicates); temperature accuracy +/-0.015 C.
quality_remarks: Table 3 N2 sea-water data, 0-40 permil salinity, 0.58-30.71 C. Bunsen coefficient defined as volume of gas reduced to STP dissolving in unit volume of solvent at the temperature of measurement under 760 Torr gas pressure. Text says 51 replicate determinations (matches 51 rows). Misprint probable in smoothed column (9.15 C, S=10.01). Chlorinity header is per mil in the image (text layer shows %). Text layer is an OCR-type layer with quotes for decimal points.
